help: One entry per county: the clerk’s official public site. kind "case-search" = the clerk says probate cases can be looked up online; "general" = the clerk’s general site or probate page (probate search online is not confirmed). Only addresses that answered (or whose domain the county itself uses) are listed; counties not listed show a plain "no verified link yet" message.

FL|Volusia.clerk: Volusia County Clerk of the Circuit Court
FL|Volusia.note: The clerk lists Probate among the case types you can look up by name or case number.

FL|Miami-Dade.note: The clerk’s online system covers civil, family and probate cases (Standard or Advanced Search).

FL|Hillsborough.clerk: Hillsborough County Clerk of Court & Comptroller
FL|Hillsborough.note: The clerk’s probate page explains how to search probate cases by name.

FL|Palm Beach.note: eCaseView is the clerk’s public case viewer; the clerk does not say it includes probate. Probate: call the clerk’s probate line, (561) 355-2986.

FL|Lee.clerk: Lee County Clerk of the Circuit Court
FL|Lee.note: General clerk site (it refuses automated checks, so the page was not machine-checked). Look for Court Records and choose Probate.

FL|Manatee.note: The clerk’s court records search; choose probate cases (case numbers start with CP).

FL|Sarasota.note: The clerk’s wills and probate page; its records search is reached from the clerk’s site.
